Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules without significant hilar or mediastinal lymphadenopathy, which helps distinguish this case from pulmonary sarcoidosis (typically associated with bilateral hilar adenopathy) and tuberculosis. This pattern of multiple non-calcified nodules in the absence of adenopathy is characteristic of necrotizing sarcoid granulomatosis.
